study: Capsule Review — exported reviewer interval evidence audit against original corrected Galar annotations
state: Method frozen before implementing this new evaluator; prior Galar cases, model outcomes and run coverage were already inspected. Software-method and synthetic demonstration only; not independent evaluation.
question: Can a private exported reviewer interval record be joined to independently source-verified original Galar corrected labels, separating images with directly visible blood labels from source-positive annotation runs merely lying in an interval's indexed span?

scope.excluded: Historical 9–10 and original 1–8 require separate provenance adapters. Future 11–20 and authors' 61–80 remain unopened. Fail closed on every non-allowlisted exam.
scope.label_source: Corrected Galar v2 2025-12-15, publisher Figshare file 60383963, SHA-256 2f5ba84c47d343d51952e78bf22183b9d04ba8c105f625af3cf9ffb20412e52f
scope.run: Maximal consecutive original corrected rows explicitly blood=1 and numeric source frame IDs spaced exactly +5. Empty/unknown or blood=0 rows and source gaps end runs.
scope.caveat: Annotation runs are not adjudicated lesions, patients or full continuously recorded events. Frames are sparse; device times unverified.

inputs.export: Locally generated Capsule Review ZIP containing review.json, selected images, saved frames and newly marked intervals; no public upload
inputs.study_manifest: Complete local /api/studies/<study_id>/manifest metadata, with study manifest SHA-256 and every imported source image/frame position
inputs.verified_source_manifest: Previously original-source verified private manifest of individual Galar source PNG hashes, exam, original source frame, blood annotation and selection roles
inputs.corrected_labels: Exact official corrected Galar ZIP SHA-256; read only one named exam.csv after whole-file checksum; NEVER testzip() entire official archive
inputs.role_gate: Require all imported source images to be from the unchanged label-blind reference set (reference_uniform=1). Reject intentionally enriched-only images.

locked_metrics.source_annotation_positive_runs: All source-positive runs in this permitted examination, not lesions.
locked_metrics.imported_representable_runs: Source-positive runs with an explicit blood=1 original image among the entire imported verified reference manifest.
locked_metrics.direct_exported_positive_images: Blood-positive labelled source frames whose exact original PNG hashes match selected images in review.json; counts distinct exported images, not detected lesions.
locked_metrics.direct_exported_positive_runs: Distinct source-positive runs with at least one exact selected blood-positive original image. No interpolated span-interior hits.
locked_metrics.explicit_frame_saved_runs: Distinct source-positive runs with >=1 exact image explicitly bookmarked or noted/labelled in its review record; separate from interval-boundary-only selection.
locked_metrics.interval_endpoint_positive_runs: Distinct runs with exact positive image selected as start or end boundary of a reviewer-marked interval.
locked_metrics.proposed_span_overlapped_runs: Distinct source-positive runs having >=1 exact corrected positive annotation source index numerically inside a reviewer-marked interval's start/end source IDs; NOT an observed/reviewed image or lesion sensitivity.
locked_metrics.span_overlap_without_direct_evidence: Overlapped source runs with no directly selected positive source image.
locked_metrics.source_run_length_strata: All denominators and per-stratum represented/direct/overlapped run counts, incl short/medium/long.
locked_metrics.negative_exams: Undefined positive-run fraction (null) when zero positive source annotation runs; selected workload still counted.
locked_metrics.workload: Count unique selected/exported images relative to verified imported references. Never infer clinician reading time, seconds, or complete-video compression.
locked_metrics.no_grouping_advantage_claim: A reviewer-marked interval may contain positive source row indices even if only negative boundary images are selected. Overlap is opportunity, not evidence; do not combine numerators.

privacy.mode: Local offline command, no cloud API/service; synthetic-only public unit tests.
privacy.identity_check: Every full study-manifest source image SHA must match a separately source-verified private acquisition manifest entry and corrected label; every exported PNG display SHA must match the complete local study manifest; interval boundaries must match imported positions and source IDs.
privacy.output: Only aggregate counts and explicitly scoped caveats in JSON. No raw medical images, private source frame indices, per-image hashes, individual prediction scores, private report notes, original manifests or checkpoints in Git or stdout.
privacy.data_retention: Private inputs/outputs reside outside public GitHub. No public GitHub Actions downloads of original Galar source data.
privacy.forbidden: Never evaluate reserved cases 11–20 or 61–80, tune model thresholds, promote clinical model, claim annotation-run == clinical lesion.

evaluation_stage: First implementation and synthetic end-to-end tests. Any original-source pilot is post-hoc exploratory, must be explicitly labelled and recorded separately, with no clinical extrapolation.
